posts.author: rosenmund
posts.text: P N Gadgil has increased its inventory hedging percentage to 80%. North India and Central India are doing great for them. Studded ratio is currently at 11.9% and should reach 17–18% going forward. ROCE will increase as the franchise business requires less capital. EBITDA margins won’t get impacted by the franchise business because even though gross margins decrease, the rest of the expenses also come down, keeping EBITDA margins intact. The same could be seen in Q2 results. Directionally, they are moving in the right direction. They are confident of maintaining 3.5–4x inventory turns. From FY2…
